limits: This manifest identifies the published source artifacts; it is not an authenticity, truth, permission, authority, or adoption claim.
The adapter profile is a bounded finite review of declared packets, not PAL v2.4 conformance and not a replacement for the published source.
PAL work recovery is distinct from grant, resource, authority, audit, and trace reset or renewal. A recovered work state does not imply equality of those non-work coordinates.
Unknown required evidence remains unknown. A fail-closed decision may decline a transition but cannot relabel an unknown check as pass, zero, or complete.
MIND, TIES, CHARTER, PECAN, PEA, SEED, and other frameworks remain separately sourced; proximity does not make them PAL layers or dependencies.
Tests named T73, T74, and T75 are source test specifications. They are not execution receipts or evidence that the wider PAL obligations are closed.
